node.title: Re^2: Mojolicious absolute url with query in template?
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext: Thanks for replying. I tried adding ->query before asking the question, because it seemed logical, but it didn't work as expected. This displays the url without the query string: <%= url_for('/')->to_abs %> But this displays absolutely nothing: <%= url_for('/')->to_abs->query %> Here's the weird part, a link made with "to_abs->query" works, but can't be right clicked ("Void" link with click handler) and when source is viewed the href appears to be blank: Reload What is this voodoo?
